subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Which permanent Telegram album API should OpenClaw support for this issue: album semantics on the existing `mediaUrls` send paths, the external draft's new `send-media-group`/`filePaths` action, or no native album feature for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the model-facing action shape and cross-path delivery semantics changes a public channel/tool contract and should not be guessed by cleanup automation while an external draft with closing syntax is still open.

options.title: Port album semantics onto `mediaUrls`
options.body: Use existing structured media payloads and add `sendMediaGroup` only as an eligible Telegram delivery optimization with sequential fallback.

options.title: Adopt the external draft action
options.body: Review and reshape the external draft's `send-media-group`/`filePaths` API as the supported model-facing action surface, accepting a new action contract.

options.title: Defer native albums
options.body: Keep current sequential fanout as supported behavior and document that Telegram albums are not a current OpenClaw guarantee.

recommendation.title: Port album semantics onto `mediaUrls`
recommendation.body: Use existing structured media payloads and add `sendMediaGroup` only as an eligible Telegram delivery optimization with sequential fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the shared reply-payload helper/API shape and bundled Telegram plugin boundary, both connected to steipete's issue context and recent helper history.
